concept.zh: 两条产线 · 单件单配 · 最小公差
concept.en: Two lines · Each battery used once · Minimum tolerance

brief.zh: left 和 right 是两条产线按电量升序排好的列表。配一对必须从两线各选一块，每块只能用一次，电量差的绝对值不能超过公差。求至少凑到 required 对所需的最小整数公差。required 为 0 时返回 0；如果数量不够，无论公差多大都凑不齐，返回 -1。
brief.en: left and right are two production lines sorted by charge. Each pair uses one battery from each line, and every battery can be used at most once. The absolute charge difference for a pair cannot exceed the tolerance. Find the minimum integer tolerance that allows at least required pairs. Return zero for a target of zero or -1 if there are too few batteries regardless of tolerance.
